scope: The surviving Busch Stadium opened in 2006, with the red-brick gate elevations, three-tier seating bowl, open northeast view, baseball diamond, two current-generation outfield board housings, canopy and lighting structures.

originalReview.notes: The view faces into the open center and right field upper area. It shows the two board housings, green batter’s eye, red lower balconies, outfield terraces and tall lamp structures. Temporary soccer markings and 2013 scoreboard contents are specific to the event.
Aerial shows a three-deck horseshoe with dark narrow roof over the top back rows, brick gate piers, regular red seat sections, green field and open northeast/outfield edge.
On-site close view establishes red molded seats with dark armrests, a slim seat-back slot and round numbering plates.

quallaSearch.notes: Screened the published Qualla media first. The exact 2013 CC0 image was matched to Commons and supplies the center-field form. The two supplemental CC0 originals establish the whole roof/stand outline and seat details. The seven other candidate files are 2007 transfers of 2006 photographs for which the native page does not preserve the creator’s original release record.
